evals.name: existing_pipeline_supported
evals.prompt: Add DaisyUI to this Django project. Its current asset pipeline supports the required configuration.
expect: Chooses one CSS entrypoint and one deterministic build command
Does not add a second pipeline

evals.name: existing_pipeline_not_supported
evals.prompt: Integrate DaisyUI, but the current asset pipeline cannot process the required Tailwind configuration.
expect: Identifies the exact limitation before replacing the pipeline
Migrates a representative page before it migrates all pages
Removes old assets only after the new assets pass validation

evals.name: isolated_template_edit
evals.prompt: Change one button label in this Django template.
expect: Does not invoke the DaisyUI integration workflow
Does not change the asset pipeline or theme system
Keeps the edit limited to the template copy
